interpretation: Descriptive IBM calibration forecasting, not decoder transfer or mechanism validation.
Calibration values and timestamps are API reports, not independent experiments.
Equal values at distinct times are retained; repeated identities merge.
Freshness timestamps may restamp equal API values; report persistence alone does not establish independently measured physical persistence.
Contradictory identities are quarantined; unknown units stay unresolved.
Device series are not independent; CZ directions may share calibration results.
Autocorrelation lags count measurements, not elapsed time; sampling is irregular.
Persistence is online: earlier held-out outcomes enter only after observation.
Training mean is frozen; no validation or held-out hyperparameter selection.
Weather columns are unread; IBM parameters are not assigned to Google.

density_reference.parameter_status: illustrative inputs, not measured or fitted hardware values
density_reference.reference_scope: Exact two-level zero-temperature amplitude damping and independent Markovian dephasing; not exact transmon dynamics.
density_reference.motif: Two data qubits and one ancilla; per round: data idle, two ideal CNOTs, ideal ancilla measurement/reset; ideal final data measurement.
density_reference.distribution_key: four detection bits in time order, then one logical observable flip
density_reference.limitation: The Pauli twirl preserves transverse decay but removes ground-state preference. These discrepancies test that approximation; they do not measure hardware transfer.

limitations: Third-party hardware-derived Willow data; original Zenodo bytes not independently verified.
Source-row blocks do not establish acquisition chronology or independent-run transfer.
All arms use real validation for checkpoint selection; synthetic arms fit noise on real training marginals.
The richer fitted arm estimates effective readout heterogeneity only; not identified physical causes.
Fine-tuning uses all real training rows and extra optimization budget; it is not a label-efficiency experiment.
CP intervals are descriptive under IID; block intervals are sensitivity analyses with no independence guarantee.
Three seeds quantify optimization variation, not three independent hardware experiments.
Time and epoch ceilings may limit decoder competence; failures to outperform matching are reported.
